visual_storytelling.emotional_flow: The guide moves an intimidated newcomer from 'I don't get this' to 'I can start with one box'. The hero lowers the guard; the honesty callout builds trust at the one place the article admits a limit; the deferred infographics (card types, deck composition, turn phases) will convert rules-complexity into orientation; the price section closes on candor where the strongest art direction is to show nothing; the related crest hands the reader their next step. Visuals stay calm and explanatory throughout - this is a teaching piece, not a hype piece.

visual_objectives.goal: Give the pillar beginner guide a premium, franchise-art-free cover and shareable OG card.
Make the honesty heads-up scannable and trustworthy via an editorial callout.
Convert rules complexity (card types, deck structure, turn phases) into glanceable diagrams.
Give the buyer-guide next step a recognisable, clickable identity.
Reinforce editorial candor by omitting a price visual.

visual_inventory.why_this_visual_exists: A premium, franchise-art-free cover at the H1 sets a calm, authoritative teaching tone for an intimidated newcomer.
visual_inventory.reader_loses_without: Without it the pillar guide opens like a generic blog and loses the trust cue that keeps a nervous beginner reading.

mobile_considerations: Mobile-first for Voyage Log's primary audience. Every original degrades to a single readable column near 390px; the hero watermark hides below 640px (matching the Wave A grid); callout stays full-width; the related crest tile scales while the card stays >=44px tappable. Deferred infographics (v5/v6/v7) must be designed portrait-first even though not injected this phase.

performance_budget.prefer: inline SVG / CSS data-URIs; no new network requests; no new webfont
performance_budget.notes: Phase-1 visuals are pure CSS + inline SVG (zero extra requests). The OG is produced as source SVG only this phase; PNG rasterisation is deferred and would be build-time only.

copyright_trust_risks.mitigation: All visuals are original geometry/typography; no official image, card face, or character art; no record.json image asset consumed.

copyright_trust_risks.risk: A price visual would imply false certainty.
